retraction.reason: Retracted in M42 batch 16 under brief §1: the record earns no honest edge. The English article, at revision 1375700231, says the war "began following the military coup on 1 February 2021", which "triggered mass anti-coup demonstrations and a violent crackdown by the Tatmadaw, which significantly escalated the country's longstanding insurgencies", and traces the older insurgencies to the 1962 coup and the 8888 uprising. None of the four is a record here and the atlas holds nothing at all of Burma or Myanmar. It waits on the 2021 Myanmar coup d'état.
